description: Tests whether a design sprint is the right tool for a client's problem and produces a qualification memo plus the words to say if the answer is no, part of the Design Sprint Pack by Polar Bear. Use this whenever the user says "run sprint-qualifier", "should we run a sprint", "the client wants a design sprint", "is this a sprint problem", "scope a sprint for this client", or when a sprint has been requested and nobody has checked whether it fits. Use it even for a vague ask like "a client asked us for a workshop week, thoughts?"
